theme: 3 terms for passing values through SwiftUI views: down to children, up to the parent and listening for it

terms.definition: A protocol for a key that gives your own value a default in the environment.
terms.example: Add an EnvironmentKey for the theme.

terms.definition: A protocol for a key that lets a child view send a value up to its parent.
terms.example: Use a PreferenceKey to send the width to the parent.

terms.definition: A modifier that runs code in a parent view when a preference value changes.
terms.code:
Text("Hi")
    .preference(key: WidthKey.self, value: 50)
    .onPreferenceChange(WidthKey.self) { w in
        print(w)
    }

video.title: EnvironmentKey, PreferenceKey & onPreferenceChange | Day 169
video.description:
Learn to explain how values travel through the SwiftUI view tree: EnvironmentKey, PreferenceKey & onPreferenceChange, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
EnvironmentKey - A protocol for a key that gives your own value a default in the environment.
PreferenceKey - A protocol for a key that lets a child view send a value up to its parent.
onPreferenceChange - A modifier that runs code in a parent view when a preference value changes.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain EnvironmentKey, PreferenceKey & onPreferenceChange in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.

EnvironmentKey - A protocol for a key that gives your own value a default in the environment.
한국어: 인바이런먼트키: 내가 만든 값에 환경 속 기본값을 주는 키를 위한 프로토콜

PreferenceKey - A protocol for a key that lets a child view send a value up to its parent.
한국어: 프리퍼런스키: 자식 뷰가 부모 뷰로 값을 위로 보낼 수 있게 해 주는 키를 위한 프로토콜

onPreferenceChange - A modifier that runs code in a parent view when a preference value changes.
한국어: 온프리퍼런스체인지: 프리퍼런스 값이 바뀔 때 부모 뷰에서 코드를 실행하는 수정자

landscape.hook: Can you explain EnvironmentKey, PreferenceKey and onPreferenceChange in English?

dialogue.title: Up and down
dialogue.setting: SwiftUI data flow in the view tree

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I want my own theme value in the environment, like the accent name.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Create an EnvironmentKey. It gives your own value a default in the environment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Like `AccentKey` in the code, with `blue` as the default?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Every EnvironmentKey needs a default value.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Now a parent view must know the width of a child.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The environment goes down, so you need a PreferenceKey. It lets a child send a value up to its parent.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is a PreferenceKey like an environment value?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It is the opposite direction. A PreferenceKey goes up, and an EnvironmentKey goes down.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: In the code, the child calls `.preference` with `WidthKey`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. Then the parent listens with onPreferenceChange.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It runs code in the parent whenever the preference value changes.
